# Pathway (`pathway` v1)

A biological pathway and the genes that take part in it.

**Group:** Genomics and biology · **Mnemonic:** `PWY` · **Identifiers:** `PWY-…` in `pathwayId`

Open one with `PWY <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: pathway
version: 1
description: A biological pathway and the genes that take part in it.
match: { kind: pathway, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Genomics and biology · Pathway, id: $.pathwayId }
strip:
  - { label: Pathway, bind: $.name, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Category, bind: $.category }
  - { label: Genes, bind: $.geneCount, fmt: amount0 }
panels:
  - id: members
    kind: table
    title: Member genes
    key: F2
    rows: $.members
    columns:
      - { label: Gene, bind: "@.symbol" }
      - { label: Role, bind: "@.role" }
      - { label: Location, bind: "@.location" }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
keys: { F8: impact, F9: raw }
```

| Genes | `$.geneCount` | `amount0` |
